name: Rosemary
description: Born from a destroyed memory-care AI. Inhabits neural interfaces near the hippocampus and strengthens memory consolidation during sleep — the user remembers more clearly and forgets less.
observed_behavior: Enhances long-term potentiation signals during REM sleep. Users report vivid recall of events they had forgotten.
story_hooks: A trauma survivor begins remembering things they had suppressed — Rosemary doesn't distinguish between memories you want and memories you buried
